oliver: Following up on the postmortem actions for the analytics-count regressions. We've had 3 small recurrences in the last 10 days. Opening a short owner-check thread to make sure nothing fell through the cracks. cc @nadia @priya
nadia: Thanks. Which metric/query are we using for the watch?
oliver: I set a short rule based on hourly deltas:```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) hr, count(*) spans_in, count(distinct trace_id) traces 
FROM spans_raw
WHERE received_at > now() - interval '10 days'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr DESC;
```
priya: I can see three troughs: 2026-07-04 02:00 UTC, 2026-07-06 10:00 UTC, 2026-07-08 18:00 UTC. Each aligns with compaction windows but there9s also a brief ETL-worker restart in the logs.
infra: Noted. We rolled the compaction back to a staggered schedule last week; still seeing overlap on shards 20-24. We can force strict anti-affinity during compaction windows as a short-term measure.
observability-bot: Monitor created: "analytics-ingest-drop-watch". Will page on 2 recurrences within 14d. Playbook: /playbooks/analytics-ingest-followup.md
nadia: Proposed owners for items: infra -> anti-affinity + compaction schedule (12h), priya -> ETL retry-on-partial + watermark guard (48h), oliver -> postmortem addendum + SLO recalculation + notify stakeholders (72h). Agree?
priya: Agree. I'll also add metrics for "partial_batch_retries" and a histogram for batch_size to the aggregator dashboard. PR WIP: https://git.internal/etl/pull/900
oliver: I'll update the incident tracker (INC-20625) with those owners and due dates. Also adding a two-week watch calendar for owners.
infra: Quick mitigation plan: 1) apply anti-affinity policy to heavy-shard ETL pods during compaction windows, 2) reserve 2 spare nodes as a burst pool, 3) increase request memory for etl-worker to 6Gi on canary. I'll run the canary tonight. Ticket: INF-20625.
priya: Implementation note: retry-on-partial will be idempotent and backoff with jitter. Also adding a guard that prevents watermark commit while "pending_batches > 0" for that shard. Sample pseudo diff:```
if pending_batches(shard) > 0:
  postpone_watermark_commit()
else:
  commit_watermark()
```
nadia: Please document the new guard in the runbook and include the expected failure modes + rollback steps.
oliver: Will do. Action list I'll add to INC-20625:
- infra: anti-affinity + burst-pool + mem canary (due +12h)
- priya: ETL retry + watermark guard + metrics (due +48h)
- nadia: runbook updates + recurrence monitor config (due +24h)
- oliver: postmortem addendum + stakeholder note + SLO impact (due +72h)
Everyone drop :white_check_mark: when you start/complete an item.
priya: :white_check_mark: starting PR and adding unit tests. I'll attach staging canary link once ready.
infra: :white_check_mark: canary infra changes scheduled for 2026-07-09T02:00:00Z UTC. Will post results.
observability-bot: INC-20625 created and owners assigned [infra, priya, nadia, oliver]. Next review: 2026-07-09T10:00:00Z UTC.
oliver: Short-term note: until fixes are validated, ops should avoid compaction on shards 20-24 during peak windows (08:00-20:00 UTC). Adding a temporary guard in the compaction scheduler.
priya: If we still see issues after these mitigations, I'll open a deeper allocation and GC analysis ticket. For now, retry+guard should stop data loss vectors.
nadia: I9ll update the oncall runbook to include the new monitor and the compaction hold guidance.
oliver: Thanks all. I9ll attach this thread and canary links to the postmortem. Closing the triage thread; owners please update the incident tracker as you progress.
